title: The supplied package is a website dump, not a model-ready dataset

report.originalQuestion: Explore the identified data problems, clarify what is wrong, and create a report on all supplied data.

source.label: Supplied Strapi catalog export
filters: All 4,147 supplied rows; exact duplicates computed across all nine columns

evidenceFlow.title: Read
evidenceFlow.detail: Parsed the supplied UTF-8 CSV with quoted multiline descriptions.

evidenceFlow.title: Profile
evidenceFlow.detail: Counted rows, exact duplicates, candidate-key uniqueness, nulls, and normalized text variants.

metricDefinitions.label: Exact duplicate row
metricDefinitions.definition: A row whose values in all nine supplied columns exactly match another row.

metricDefinitions.label: Unique catalog row / slug
metricDefinitions.definition: One row after exact deduplication; every retained row has a distinct Slug in the supplied CSV.

methods.code:
df = pandas.read_csv(csv_path)
exact_duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()
unique_rows = len(df.drop_duplicates())

source.label: Normalized field-quality checks on the deduplicated catalog

evidenceFlow.title: Normalize
evidenceFlow.detail: Trimmed surrounding whitespace and case-folded categorical strings for comparison only; source values were not changed.

evidenceFlow.title: Validate
evidenceFlow.detail: Checked nulls, controlled-vocabulary cardinality, slug format, and photo-name reuse.

metricDefinitions.label: Outer-whitespace affected rows
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct catalog rows with leading or trailing whitespace in at least one text field.

source.label: Supplied Strapi uploads archive, one of two duplicated trees
filters: 15,803 files in each tree; variant class derived from filename prefix

evidenceFlow.title: Inventory
evidenceFlow.detail: Recursively enumerated filenames, sizes, extensions, and Strapi resize prefixes.

evidenceFlow.title: Compare
evidenceFlow.detail: Compared both relative filename sets and every corresponding file size.

metricDefinitions.label: Variant class
metricDefinitions.definition: Filename prefix thumbnail_, small_, medium_, or large_; all remaining files are grouped as original / other.

methods.code: variant = re.match(r'^(thumbnail|small|medium|large)_', filename).group(1) if matched else 'Original / other'

source.label: Filesystem inventory of both supplied uploads trees
filters: All files recursively under each uploads directory

evidenceFlow.title: Compare names
evidenceFlow.detail: The two trees contain identical relative filename sets.

evidenceFlow.title: Compare sizes
evidenceFlow.detail: Every corresponding file has the same byte size; a full byte hash of all 4.19 GiB was not required for this assessment.

metricDefinitions.label: Packaging duplicate
metricDefinitions.definition: Two supplied media trees with identical relative filenames, total byte counts, and per-file sizes.

methods.code:
relative_names_equal = set(part1_relative_paths) == set(part2_relative_paths)
per_file_sizes_equal = all(size1[p] == size2[p] for p in part1_relative_paths)

source.label: CSV photo names reconciled to one Strapi uploads tree
filters: 2,090 distinct CSV photo names; resize prefixes and trailing ten-character Strapi hashes removed before normalized-name comparison

evidenceFlow.title: Normalize CSV reference
evidenceFlow.detail: Normalized the CSV photo filename stem using Unicode normalization, case-folding, and non-alphanumeric removal.

evidenceFlow.title: Normalize archive asset
evidenceFlow.detail: Also removed Strapi resize prefixes and the trailing ten-character content token from archive filenames.

evidenceFlow.title: Classify
evidenceFlow.detail: Counted references mapping to one underlying asset hash, multiple hashes, or no normalized-name match.

metricDefinitions.label: Deterministic filename match
metricDefinitions.definition: A distinct CSV photo name that maps to exactly one Strapi asset hash under the documented normalization heuristic; this is a technical match, not proof that the image depicts the stated wine.

Below 512 px on at least one side

filters: 1,645 original WebP files reached by deterministic CSV-name matching

evidenceFlow.title: Decode
evidenceFlow.detail: Opened every deterministically matched original with Pillow and recorded width, height, and color mode.

evidenceFlow.title: Profile
evidenceFlow.detail: Computed dimension thresholds and aspect-ratio indicators relevant to field-photo recognition.

metricDefinitions.label: Image-quality flags
metricDefinitions.definition: Overlapping indicators calculated on 1,645 deterministically matched source images; percentages must not be summed.

methods.code:
with Image.open(path) as image:
    width, height = image.size

evidenceFlow.title: Hash

source.label: Supplied three-query evaluation package and manual label reading
filters: All three public query images; exact catalog text/identity comparison is based on labels visible in the supplied photos

evidenceFlow.title: Verify files
evidenceFlow.detail: Validated the supplied SHA-256 manifest for the evaluation package.

evidenceFlow.title: Inspect protocol
evidenceFlow.detail: Reviewed the request script, response parsing, timeout behavior, and queries manifest.

evidenceFlow.title: Read labels
evidenceFlow.detail: Manually inspected all three query photographs and compared visible product identities with the supplied catalog.

metricDefinitions.label: Exact catalog match
metricDefinitions.definition: The visible producer/product identity and vintage can be resolved to a supplied catalog row; this manual check is not hidden evaluation ground truth.

methods.code:
catalog_text = (wine_name + ' ' + winery + ' ' + slug).casefold()
manual_visible_labels were compared with catalog_text; no hidden ground-truth labels were available

rows.evidence: The CSV stores only a display filename; 417 of 2,090 names are unresolved and 28 are ambiguous under normalized matching.
rows.downstreamRisk: Labels cannot be assigned to image files deterministically without manual reconciliation.

rows.finding: Different catalog slugs share byte-identical images
rows.evidence: 18 SHA-256 groups span 37 distinct slugs among deterministic matches.
rows.downstreamRisk: A pure image classifier receives contradictory targets or cannot distinguish products and vintages.

rows.evidence: 2,044 of 4,147 rows (49.3%) are exact duplicates; 2,103 unique slugs remain.
rows.downstreamRisk: Naive training or sampling silently overweights almost every duplicated record.

rows.finding: The uploads archive is duplicated and uncurated
rows.evidence: Both trees contain the same 15,803 relative filenames and per-file sizes; resize derivatives and unrelated non-image files are mixed in.
rows.downstreamRisk: Storage, indexing, and sampling can double-count identical material and ingest non-product assets.

rows.finding: Public evaluation coverage is not sufficient for local accuracy measurement
rows.evidence: Only three public query images are supplied and no public ground-truth slug file is present; two visible products have no exact CSV match.
rows.downstreamRisk: Top-1, top-5, recall, or F1 cannot be measured from the supplied package.

rows.finding: Reference imagery does not represent deployment conditions
rows.evidence: Most linked assets are narrow RGBA product cutouts; the three queries are 3,024 × 4,032 shelf/camera photographs with clutter and perspective.
rows.downstreamRisk: Training only on supplied assets is unlikely to generalize to real mobile scans.

rows.finding: Several descriptive fields are uncontrolled free text
rows.evidence: The Цвет field alone has 832 distinct values across 2,103 rows, including case and whitespace variants.
rows.downstreamRisk: Filtering, stratification, and metadata-assisted retrieval become noisy and hard to validate.

source.label: Synthesized issue register from the supplied CSV, media archive, evaluation package, and technical brief
filters: Severity follows the Data quality rubric: defects that break the required catalog-to-image grain are Critical; material bias or unusable evaluation is High; localized schema inconsistency is Medium.

evidenceFlow.title: Consolidate
evidenceFlow.detail: Mapped each measured defect or limitation to the intended image-recognition use case described in the supplied brief.

evidenceFlow.title: Classify
evidenceFlow.detail: Kept confirmed defects, limitations, and interpretations distinct and assigned qualitative severity and confidence.

metricDefinitions.label: Severity
metricDefinitions.definition: Critical breaks the required training/evaluation grain; High materially biases or prevents a core use; Medium needs remediation but does not alone invalidate the package.

methods.code: For each observed issue: verify the affected population, classify defect vs limitation, map it to the required one-card identification use case, then assign severity and confidence.
